title: NoteTracker
description: View Note Block/Repeater clicks in ActionBar and lock them!
body:
# NoteTracker ♫
**The ultimate utility for Note Block enthusiasts.**

NoteTracker is a performance-friendly plugin that displays real-time information about Note Blocks and Repeaters directly in your ActionBar. It also features a unique locking system to prevent accidental changes to your musical creations.

## FEATURES:
* **Live HUD:** Look at any Note Block or Repeater to see its current state (clicks/ticks) in your ActionBar.
* **Locking Mechanism:** Lock any Note Block or Repeater by Left-Clicking it with a Honeycomb (configurable).
* **Prevention:** Once locked, blocks cannot be tuned/changed until unlocked.
* **HEX Color Support:** Fully customize all messages with modern HEX colors (e.g., `&#RRGGBB`).
* **Ultra Lightweight:** In-memory tracking with zero impact on server performance.
* **Total Customization:** Every message and the locking item can be changed in the config.
* **Ownership Tracking:** Blocks now remember who locked them. Only the owner (the player who waxed the block) can unlock it.
* **Total Protection:** Locked blocks are now immune to explosions, piston pushes, and fire burns (TNT, creepers, end crystals, and respawn anchors).
* **Admin Bypass:** A new command (`/notetracker bypass`) for administrators to manage any lock on the server.

COMMANDS:
* `/notetracker reload` - Reloads the configuration.
* `/notetracker bypass` - Toggle Admin Bypass mode.
Aliases: `/nt`, `/ntr`

PERMISSIONS:
* `notetracker.admin`: Allows reloading the plugin and using bypass mode (Default: OP).
